news.title: EPB Group 9M FY2026 Net Profit Halves to RM4.379 Million, No Dividend Declared

recent_en: EPB announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with news reporting 9M FY2026 net profit halved to RM4.379 million and no dividend declared. Meanwhile, directors Yeoh Chee Min and Ooi Kim Kew made multiple open market purchases of company shares.
notable_en: Directors Yeoh Chee Min and Ooi Kim Kew made multiple open market purchases of company shares between October and November 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with news reporting 9M FY2026 net profit halved to RM4.379 million and no dividend declared.
risks_en: 9M FY2026 net profit halved to RM4.379 million.
No dividend was declared for the quarter.
